name: xplainer
description: Turn a bug, a root cause, or an architecture decision into a short narrated explainer video with captions, rendered to one MP4.

interface.shortDescription: Explain anything as a narrated video
interface.longDescription: Build short explainer videos from inside the session: animated Remotion scenes, a synthesised voiceover, and word-level captions rendered together into one MP4. The tools run locally when a local xplainer runtime is present and against the hosted service otherwise.
defaultPrompt: Explain this bug as a ninety-second video
Turn this architecture decision into an explainer
Make a video showing what this fix actually changes
